package personalteacher

import "time"

// IDGenerator creates stable identifiers for new PersonalTeacher records.
type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID() string
}

// Clock makes time deterministic in domain tests.
type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// UpdateInput is a partial settings update protected by optimistic versioning.
type UpdateInput struct {
	StudentID          string
	ExpectedVersion    int64
	TeacherProfileID   *string
	Language           *string
	CommunicationStyle *string
	PedagogyProfile    *string
	HintPolicy         *string
	InterventionMode   *string
}

// UpdateSoulInput is a partial per-student soul update protected by its own
// optimistic version, independently from PersonalTeacher behavior settings.
type UpdateSoulInput struct {
	StudentID          string
	ExpectedVersion    int64
	DisplayName        *string
	PersonaCode        *string
	VoiceStyle         *string
	RelationshipStyle  *string
	EncouragementStyle *string
}
